records.run: observed H-alpha luminosity function (Table 3, completeness-corrected phi)

axes.xDefinition: log10 observed H-alpha line luminosity (grism line flux, not corrected for dust)
axes.yDefinition: log10 number density of H-alpha emitters per dex of luminosity from the V/Vmax method, corrected for the completeness of each source

selection.population: H-alpha emitters with line S/N > 5 and quality flag q >= 1.75 in CONGRESS (F356W grism, GOODS-North, 62 arcmin2); broad-line emitters removed
selection.warning: Observed luminosities: no dust correction. Only bins with average completeness of at least 65 per cent are tabulated. Errors are Poisson, completeness uncertainty and cosmic variance (asymmetric; the band is the printed error). Luminosity bins of 0.25 dex; each redshift bin is wide (3.8 < z < 5.1, 4.9 < z < 5.7, 5.7 < z < 6.6), and evolution inside the bin is not modelled.

definitions.apertureDefinition: total grism line flux of the whole galaxy (spatially resolved, no flux loss in principle)
definitions.population: H-alpha emitters in the grism surveys, broad-line emitters removed (star-forming galaxies and narrow-line AGN)

provenance.citation: Covelo-Paz et al. 2025, A&A 694, A178 (arXiv:2409.17241), Table 3
provenance.definitionBasis: line: the paper calls the measured quantity the H-alpha flux and models H-alpha, [NII] and [SII] as separate lines in its completeness simulations; it does not say in a sentence that the real fluxes exclude [NII] (read, not stated). densityFrame: Mpc^-3 is not called comoving anywhere (read, not stated).

records.notes: Table 3 transcribed (6 bins of 0.25 dex, 321 of the 527 H-alpha emitters of the redshift bin; bins below 65 per cent average completeness are not tabulated). Checks: the Table 4 Schechter fit (log L*=42.6, phi*=0.89e-3, alpha=-1.64) agrees with every point to within 2 sigma of the printed error (rms 0.76 sigma), which also shows the table is per dex; the number of sources in the bins is below the 527 the text gives for the redshift bin.
